hiring.positions_note: None open today: the public Portal de Provisión Docente provides rolling CV registration and selection stages, but displays no discrete academic vacancies or Medicina/Internal Medicine post.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No published requirement about foreign degrees, revalidación, or Chilean nationality was shown. The portal only says applicants submit “documentación académica y/o profesional ... para cada campo.”

international.notes: The published Medicina curriculum includes Inglés Básico and Inglés Técnico, rather than medical subjects taught in English. Internationalisation lists COIL, exchanges and 49 agreements with 33 institutions in 11 countries; contact: relint@udalba.cl.

profile_paragraphs: Medicine is part of UDALBA’s Facultad de Ciencias de la Salud. It awards Médico Cirujano and Licenciado en Medicina, is daytime, lasts 14 semesters, and is offered in La Serena and Santiago.
Medicine started academic activity in Santiago and La Serena in 2007. The current faculty organisational structure dates from the 2020 reorganisation.
The Medicina programme holds CNA accreditation for three years, from 7 January 2026 to 7 January 2029.

For a rheumatologist, the clearest clinical link is the listed practice site Hospital San Pablo de Coquimbo, whose own site reports a rheumatology team. UDALBA’s public academic portal supports rolling applications but had no listed post on 3 September 2026.
